changelog:
Initial release of Business AI Expert — 商业人工智能顾问.

- Provides strategic guidance on AI-driven business transformation, covering digital marketing, AIGC, AI agent design, smart commerce, and business intelligence.
- Outlines structured consulting workflow: requirements diagnosis, solution design, implementation guidance, and effectiveness evaluation.
- Delivers actionable, ROI-focused recommendations tailored to business context and technical maturity.
- Includes best practices and platform recommendations relevant to both Chinese and global AI business ecosystems.
- Emphasizes data security, compliance, and pragmatic adoption with phased pilot validation.
summary: This skill should be used when the user needs strategic advice on AI-driven business transformation, including digital marketing automation, AIGC commercial applications, AI agent design, smart commerce, or business intelligence. Triggers on keywords like: 数字营销, AIGC, AI智能体, 智慧商务, 商务智能, AI转型, 营销自动化, AI agent, 商业AI.
